title: land and dispatch name a host item's branch and merge request by the kb id, so a workspace whose repositories enforce their own task-id branch and MR-title rules cannot land (Nerthus adoption)
goal: A multi-repository item with an external tracker id is dispatched on a branch and landed from merge requests named by a template backlog.json sets from that id (the Nerthus workspace: branch proj/<nn>-<mm>-<slug>, MR title '<task id>: <title>', a 'Task: <task id>' trailer), so a host whose repositories' CI refuses any other branch name, MR title or trailer lands an item without changing those rules; with no template set the kb's work/<id> and '<id>:' stay the default

run: import sys,inspect; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bl_land,bl_dispatch; a="title_prefix=f\"{iid}:\"" in inspect.getsource(bl_land.land_repositories); b="WORK_PREFIX + iid" in inspect.getsource(bl_dispatch.worker_branch); sys.exit(1 if a and b else 0)

repro_reason: landing needs a live forge with merged requests; the names are fixed by these two expressions in land_repositories and worker_branch

gates.question: How does backlog.json name a host item's branch, merge request title and trailer?
options: one naming object of templates (branch, mr_title, trailer) filled from the tracker id, item id and slug
a naming object per repository under repositories
gates.recommendation: one naming object of templates (branch, mr_title, trailer) filled from the tracker id, item id and slug

notes: Measured 2026-10-23 in a throwaway clone of the Nerthus workspace: land of a story whose task (P08-05) has a merged '<task id>:' request stops at step requests with "no merge request titled 'ST-dl7mgwpd:' (state none)", and done refuses the same item with "the work of an item with repos is merged in its repositories, which land reads through their merge requests: run land", so a host whose requests carry its own ids has no landing path at all. The same done printed "the docs check could not run: cannot read kb/_self/map.csv" with docs_map empty (ST-m7uk3zpu). Not planned into a sprint: the goal leaves the template's shape open and the code is agents-rule (bl_land.py, bl_dispatch.py, bl_base.py), so a blocking operator gate comes before code. Ran the repro as filed: both expressions are in the source (title_prefix=f"{iid}:" in land_repositories, WORK_PREFIX + iid in worker_branch), exit 1; it reads source text, kept as filed because the template setting has no name yet, and it must be rewritten on a planted workspace once the gate settles it. Open choices: the setting's name and keys (branch, request title, trailer), how an external tracker id P08-05 and an item title fill <nn>-<mm>-<slug> and <task id>, and whether the done and brief checks that read work/<id> (WORK_PREFIX referrers: bl_clean.py:90, bl_close.py:43, bl_dispatch.py:44, bl_land.py:33) follow the template or only land and dispatch do. Referrers to plan then: worker_branch (bl_dispatch.py:266, 9 lines), land_repositories (bl_land.py:1054; backlog.md:302; tools.md:118). The done message about docs_map empty (ST-m7uk3zpu) is that item's, not this one's. Touches will share bl_dispatch.py with BG-duzrzr2d and bl_base.py with BG-cmvwrpbr and BG-c7pjl3mi: depend on those when planned.
